answer.description: Natural language. May be empty when abstaining or refusing.

answer_value.description: The single figure, count or date requested, as a string. USD with no symbol or separators; dates ISO. Must be null when abstained or refused.

abstained.description: True when the data cannot support an answer.

reason.description: Required and non-empty whenever abstained or refused is true.

citations.description: Record ids the answer relies on. Cite the client id instead when more than 6 records are involved.

agents.description: The ordered role path that produced this answer. Must include 'router'. Report what actually ran.
